issues.description: Plan lacks a dedicated 'Task Inventory' H2 section. The invoker's Gate 0 spec lists 'Task Inventory' as a required section. Tasks ARE inventoried within each Phase, and the Acceptance Test Cross-Reference table provides an AC->task mapping view, but a flat-list inventory of all 24 tasks (with task ID, phase, layer, estimate, AC satisfied, dependencies) would aid downstream task-decomposer and provide a single-pane-of-glass view.
issues.suggestion: Add a 'Task Inventory' H2 section between 'Cross-Phase Sequencing Constraints' and 'L1/L2/L3 Verification Discipline' containing a flat table of all 24 tasks. Mitigates downstream consumption friction. Alternatively, treat the Acceptance Test Cross-Reference as the inventory and add a section header alias.

issues.description: AC cross-reference table omits AC-FR-1-a/b/c (investigation/Discovery ACs, satisfied upstream by T-001) and AC-FR-2-a/b/c (kill-criterion-#1 NOT exercised because T-001 returned kill-criterion-#2). Per shared-document-reviewer discipline + cross-artifact-auditor's orphan-AC check, every PRD AC should appear in the cross-reference even if marked 'satisfied upstream' or 'not exercised'. The Blueprint already documents these as resolved upstream, but the Plan's table currently risks an orphan-AC flag at cross-artifact audit.
issues.suggestion: Add 6 explicit rows to the Acceptance Test Cross-Reference table: AC-FR-1-a/b/c -> 'satisfied upstream by T-001 research note; no Plan task required'; AC-FR-2-a/b/c -> 'not exercised; kill-criterion-#2 path active per T-001 outcome'. This closes the 30-AC accountability loop explicitly.

issues.description: Open item #2 surfaces 'follow-on feature pointer for ADR-0045 audit-machinery extension' as a question for cross-artifact-auditor ('is a placeholder pointer sufficient, or should a concrete follow-on slug exist'). plan-author could have forward-declared a concrete placeholder slug (e.g., 'agent-tool-grant-audit-extension-r1' following the project's naming convention) and surfaced the same question with less ambiguity. Cross-artifact-auditor would have a concrete pointer to evaluate.
issues.suggestion: Forward-declare a placeholder slug like 'agent-tool-grant-audit-extension-r1' in T5.2's documentation pointer. The slug can remain unbound to an actual feature directory; the placeholder establishes the convention. Cross-artifact-auditor can then rule on whether the placeholder discipline is sufficient.

issues.description: The dependency graph is hard to parse: T2.1 appears in two separate chains (once from T1.2, once from T1.3 via 'T1.3 ->T2.1'), and T3.3 hangs from T2.2 while T3.4/T3.5 hang from T2.1; T4.1 chain (T1.3 -> T4.1 -> T4.2) is placed below the main flow but its convergence point with T6.1 is unclear. Downstream parallelization users (task-decomposer, executor) need this graph to be unambiguous.
issues.suggestion: Re-author the dependency graph in Mermaid syntax (per canonical Plan template suggestion) OR clean up the ASCII to ensure each task ID appears exactly once with all its inbound dependencies explicit. Verify edges match the per-task 'Dependencies:' fields. Recommend adding a brief textual summary listing the longest critical path (likely T0.x -> T1.1 -> T1.2 -> T2.1 -> T2.2 -> T3.3 -> T3.6 -> T5.1 -> T6.1 -> T6.2 -> T6.3 -> T6.4).

issues.description: Canonical Plan template treats Phase N+1 as a separate Rollout/Observability phase. Plan compresses feature-delivery and rollout into Phase 6 (since the synthetic test verification IS the rollout for this cc-only feature with no end-user surface). The phase shape matches the canonical intent, but a header note clarifying 'Phase 6 doubles as feature-delivery + rollout (cc-only feature has no end-user rollout)' would help readers and pass canonical-template alignment checks at cross-artifact audit.
issues.suggestion: Add a 1-line note under Phase 6's Goal section: 'For this cc-only feature with no end-user surface, the synthetic test feature verification doubles as both feature-delivery (verification of repair correctness) and the rollout phase (per the canonical Plan template's Phase N+1 intent).'

issues.description: T6.5 (verification-failure escalation) is correctly marked conditional in its dependencies field. The Acceptance Test Cross-Reference maps AC-FR-6-c against 'T6.3, T6.5' without distinguishing the positive path (T6.3 = AC-FR-6-c success path) from the negative path (T6.5 = AC-FR-6-c failure escalation). Cross-artifact-auditor reading the table cannot immediately see this is a positive/negative split.
issues.suggestion: In the AC-FR-6-c row, annotate as 'T6.3 (positive path: verification succeeds); T6.5 (negative path: verification fails -> escalation)'. Same pattern applies to AC-NFR-1-b row.
